document: Following up on our earlier order PO-70931, please find the new order details below. This purchase order, PO-38114, was placed with Tessellate Inc on April 4, 2026 (the vendor quote itself was dated March 27, 2026). We are ordering 262 units; list price $1,780.07 less a 10% volume discount of $178.01. Ship to our warehouse in Boise; invoices go to head office in Madison.

schema.delivery_city: string: city goods are delivered to
schema.order_date: date YYYY-MM-DD: the date the order was placed (not a delivery or quote date)
schema.payment_terms_days: integer: payment due within N days; null if not stated
schema.po_number: string: the purchase order number of THIS order (format PO-#####), not any referenced earlier order
schema.total_usd: number: final amount payable in USD AFTER any discount
